title: prunus × ferganica
intro: Prunus × ferganica, commonly known as Apricot kernel, is a plant derived from the seeds of Prunus armeniaca, a deciduous tree native to Central Asia. The kernel of the apricot seed has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Prunus × ferganica include its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Prunus × ferganica include amygdalin, a compound with reported anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
